final: WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), r AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rk FROM c) SELECT customer_id, order_count, share FROM r WHERE rk <= (SELECT MIN(rk) FROM (SELECT rk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rn FROM r) WHERE rn = MIN((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r), 10)) ORDER BY share DESC
